quote: (b) Effective Date.--This section and the amendment made by this section--(1) shall take effect on October 1, 2001, and (2) shall apply to fiscal years beginning on or after that date.
note: Applies only to fiscal years beginning on or after October 1, 2001; no pending-case language.

No effective-date/applicability language was provided for sec. 104 in the excerpts. The quoted provisions shown concern other sections (e.g., secs. 1504, 1506, 1509, 1510, 1511, 1601, 2003, 2004), so defaulting to enactment.
